notes.title: DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
After several patches and improvements to Alchemy Emporium, we have finally released the Free Demo on Steam.
In the Demo you will have 4 weeks of gameplay to try out all the features.

[b]The best advice we can give you is to try the game with the demo before you buy it![/b]

notes.notes:
Here is a list of the bugs fixed with [b]patch 1.3[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the interface to disappear after learning a perk. And it did not allow the game to proceed.
Now you can load the save that was causing you this problem and continue your game!
[*] Fixed a visual bug in the alchemist summary panel and in the tools panel;
[*] Other minor fixes.
[/list]

Special thanks to the user who sent us the log to better recognize the error he had identified (new user than yesterday).

We are still working on all the other feedbacks and bugs.
If you have any consideration or you find a bug, please post it here or in the Steam discussions and we will do our best to solve them. Thank you!

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Here is a list of the bugs fixed with [b]patch 1.2[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug that in late stages caused the interruption of the activity and led to not being able to proceed in the game;
[*] The selling activity has been improved. Until now, not satisfying customers could lead to progressively fewer and fewer customers down to zero. This was intentional, but it resulted in the loss of the game. We have entered a minimum customer limit. So that we always have at least one or more loyal customers to sell potions to.
To maintain a high reputation we recommend that you sell potions with the confirmed (green) label, when possible entertain and explain the potion to the customer and sell potions with low toxicity. The toxicity can be deduced during the tasting, or from the color of the potion once the double green label is reached.
[/list]

Special thanks to the user who sent us the log to better recognize the error he had identified.

We are still working on all the other feedbacks and bugs.
[i]If you have any consideration or you find a bug, please post it here or in the Steam discussions and we will do our best to solve them. Thank you![/i]

notes.title: Release date and trailer
notes.notes:
With this trailer we are happy to announce that the game will be released on [b]Wednesday May 26[/b], 2021 at 3pm CEST.

The challenge of this trailer was to try to insert at least one second of all aspects of the game, to make it clear how many things can be done inside this game. It wasn't easy as we also wanted to keep it short enough.

We also realized that the game couldn't really be fully explained in such a short time, so we preferred to showcase most of the available activities and content.

We hope you enjoy it and we look forward to seeing you on Wednesday May 26 for the [b]game's release![/b]

notes.title: Shop and Ring evolution!
notes.notes:
The shop and the Ring are two elements to which we paid particular attention. Already in the very first draft of the shop you can find the light projected through the door that opens to indicate that a customer has just crossed the threshold of the shop.
The Ring is made up of several layers that can be replaced to create the effect necessary for the activity that is taking place within Alchemy Emporium.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38701144/9ee2a752ceb904ebac725b4bb6d327c72a038866.png[/img]

notes.title: Perks and Bulletin Board evolution!
notes.notes:
Like many other elements of the game, the perks have gone from a very generic draft, useful for better understanding its use, to a much more detailed final version.
The bulletin board, on the other hand, is much more complex and articulated. For this reason, after the first draft, we have further refined the graphics to make it in line with the rest of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38701144/ab9a06624bdc9892c252757abedfd74fe959bded.png[/img]

notes.title: Game progression - Knowledge!
notes.notes:
Books are essential for raising the alchemist level and unlocking new perks. They can be purchased from suppliers and cover a variety of topics. Additionally, the alchemist's readiness for learning, perks, weather, and helpers can change the learning rate!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38701144/63231f858697e3e965c45d868312ace023cefb49.png[/img]

notes.title: Game progression - Perks!
notes.notes:
By reading the books through the appropriate activity you will level up and you can choose one of the three perks selected according to your readings.
There are over 240 different perks in Alchemy Emporium to help you customize your play style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38701144/e34ba30739534a698bb6c7f3b2085cd971da8667.png[/img]

notes.title: Game progression - Tools
notes.notes:
These tools drawn on the blackboard, together with the alchemist level, will allow you to progress within Alchemy Emporium.
By unlocking the two tools and the related alchemist level you will have access to new ingredients that can also be combined with the previous ones to create new potions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38701144/d5f64e5ac028832678feb3ae4a311313ecdfe8fa.jpg[/img]

You'll have many alternatives, but be careful not to get caught!

notes.title: Thanks for playing the Demo!
notes.notes:
[b]Thanks for playing the Alchemy Emporium Demo[/b], we are very happy with the constructive feedback we have received.

We are already working on implementing all the screens you haven't seen yet and improving the ones you tried in the demo!

Most of the feedback is asking to improve interactivity and make the game more rewarding.
We also found that some aspects of the game are not very clear. One of the most fascinating parts of Alchemy Emporium is discovering all the game mechanics. We are implementing a system that will allow you to continue discovering the game throughout the game campaign.

We will be posting updates on the game every week, so check it out every now and then!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38701144/653e53c150b0b13ac4532c93f949a8b473ee96ce.jpg[/img]

Try the Demo!
Live Stream Demo Alchemy Emporium
notes.notes:
During the Live Stream, we will show the game in its current state of development ːpanfluteː

What you will see:
[list]
[*] All the main activities of the game starting from the purchase of the ingredients to the sale to the customer;
[*] The settings to create the campaign with: partners, villages, orders and the character skill point selection;
[*] Some of the side activities (for example the hiring of helpers);
[*] Game mechanics and much more!
[/list]

You will be able to ask questions about the concept, the development process, the game system and anything you might be interested in.

Please try the demo and Wishlist the game! 
If you have any kind of feedback, please add it to the discussion in the Steam discussion we will create just before the Demo release.

Hope you will enjoy the demo and the Stream Event!
